mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, ticket_id, sender_type, sender_id, sender_name, content, create_time FROM dms_shop_service_ticket_reply WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_shop_service_ticket_reply (tenant_id, ticket_id, sender_type, sender_id, sender_name, content) SELECT #{tenantId}, #{ticketId}, #{senderType}, #{senderId}, #{senderName}, #{content} WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_service_ticket ticket WHERE ticket.id = #{ticketId} AND ticket.tenant_id = #{tenantId})
